units.source_text: 低着头，浑身赤裸的女人后背，看上去十分猥亵，活脱脱一副野兽状。

en.t: With her head bowed, the woman's completely naked back looked intensely obscene, just like the body of a wild beast.

units.source_text: 甚至好像能抓住子宫翻个面似的。

en.t: It even seemed as if he could seize the womb and turn it inside out.

units.source_text: 然而，就在这一闪念之际，极度的屈辱感使他快要窒息了。

en.t: Yet in that very flash of thought, an extreme sense of humiliation nearly choked him.

units.source_text: 不久后，他成了虐待女人的狱卒，那身影在女人涂满了沙子的屁股上映照了出来。

en.t: Before long, he had become a jailer abusing the woman, and that figure was reflected on her sand-coated buttocks.
In any case, that is how it is...

units.source_text: 而且，到那天，你便丧失了发言权……

en.t: And when that day comes, you will have lost the right to speak...
